considerations: Filter known administrative scripts and managed automation.
Review the full command line and initiating process ancestry.
Correlate destinations with internal DNS, proxy logs and approved intelligence.
Review the surrounding device timeline before broadening the lookback.
description: Scope outbound PowerShell connections on monitored devices and correlate them with published behavior and local incident evidence.

evidence.claim: Microsoft observed PowerShell downloading an MSI after fraudulent remote support access.

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: PowerShell used to retrieve a payload may leave a process-attributed network event.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Suspicious PowerShell Network Activity

1.json:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (
    "powershell.exe",
    "pwsh.exe"
)
| where isnotempty(RemoteIP)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
